fusions.name: Two-Handed Wrench
fusions.desc: Grips the target in both hands and wrenches. It deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle Drumming
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with both fists. It deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Silverback Display
fusions.desc: Beats your chest: pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds, and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Grip
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
